text: . Two Singapore-registered container ships, GFS PRIDE and GFS GISELLE, were struck by unknown projectiles while transiting the Strait of Hormuz. The Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore reported that the GFS PRIDE caught fire and sank, but all 21 crew members evacuated safely without injury. The GFS GISELLE sustained hull damage but reached a safe anchorage under its own propulsion. Its 22 crew members were also safe and uninjured. No Singaporeans were aboard either vessel. The authority condemned the incidents, expressing deep concern over ongoing attacks on commercial shipping in the region.Islamic Revolution Guard Corps (IRGC) Navy commander Ali Azmaei announced that the IRGC Navy and the Iranian Army’s Navy maintain round-the-clock control over the Gulf, the Strait of Hormuz, and the Gulf of Oman. The IRGC Navy commander stated that passing vessels must secure authorization under international regulations and warned of a decisive response against any ships violating the rules due to U.S. provocation.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi is completing 25 years in public service, a journey defined by the mantra of Jan Seva Se Desh Seva, and a relentless commitment that continues. Guided by this vision for Seva and Sushasan, the Government has been ceaselessly working towards achieving the goal of a Viksit Bharat by 2047. Through inclusive development and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming lives. Today, in our special series, we bring you an instance of how this vision has been translated into creation of the post of Chief of Defence Staff.Earlier, India’s three armed services – Army, Navy and the Air Force – planned, trained, procured and advised the government separately. Proposals for greater jointness had been made repeatedly since the Kargil Review Committee of 1999 and the Group of Ministers that followed it, but no single officer held authority across all three services. On the 15th of August 2019, Prime Minister Narendra Modi, in his Independence Day address, announced the creation of the post of Chief of Defence Staff from the ramparts of the Red Fort. Prime Minister Modi said this will lead to better coordination among the three services.The Cabinet approved the decision in December 2019, along with a new Department of Military Affairs within the Ministry of Defence for the CDS to head.  Talking to Akashvani News, retired Lt General Sanjay Kulkarni said the appointment of CDS made it possible for the government to have one point of contact for advice on allmiltarymatters.After the formation of the post of CDS, all three forces have now got effective leadership at the top level.

. India have set a target of 224 runs for the West Indies in the third T20 International at Holkar Stadium in Indore. Put into bat, India were all out for 223 runs in the allotted 20 overs. Abhishek Sharma played a superb 69 runs off 30 balls.In reply, West Indies were 16 for 1 in 3 overs, when reports last came in.The five-match series is currently level at one match apiece, after West Indies defeated India by six wickets in the second T20 International in Ranchi on Friday evening. India had defeated West Indies by eight wickets in the opening T20 in Lucknow.

. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast heavy rainfall over coastal and South Interior Karnataka, Kerala, Mahe, Tamil Nadu and Puducherry for the next 2-3 days. The IMD said thunderstorms accompanied with lightning and gusty winds may prevail over Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Uttarakhand, Sub-Himalayan West Bengal, Sikkim, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram and Tripura tomorrow. Meanwhile, Konkan and Goa may experience Hot and Humid weather tomorrow.

. The Israel Defence Forces (IDF) today said that it had killed a Hamas commander in an airstrike in Gaza City. The commander, identified as Momen Ahmad Salameh Ay, allegedly held Israeli hostages in Hamas captivity in Gaza City and served as an aide to commanders of Hamas’s Gaza Brigade. According to the Israeli military, he had recently advanced attacks against Israeli soldiers and civilians and attempted to restore Hamas’s capabilities. In a statement, the IDF said, it had taken steps to minimize civilian casualties ahead of the airstrike, which was carried out yesterday.

. North Korea has said that it has test-fired cruise missiles designed to be fired from submarines. The move comes as Pyongyang continues to expand its military capabilities during a prolonged freeze in diplomacy with Washington and Seoul. North Korean state media said the military tested two types of these missiles in the country’s eastern waters yesterday. However, the report did not specify whether they were launched from an actual submarine or an underwater test platform. South Korea’s military did not immediately comment on the tests.

. Global oil supply is projected to decline by 5.8 million ​barrels per day (bpd) to an average of 100.7 million bpd this year, before rebounding by 7.7 million ​bpd in 2027. However, the International Energy Agency (IEA) has warned that renewed attacks in the Gulf have made the recovery fragile. According to the IEA’s monthly Oil Market Report released today, global oil supply increased by 2.5 million bpd month-on-month in September, driven by Gulf producers. However, the IEA noted that the recent escalation in attacks on regional energy infrastructure and tanker traffic threatens to derail further gains.Meanwhile, the IEA forecast that oil demand would fall by an average of 2.6 million barrels per day in 2026. Diesel is expected to account for 25 per cent of that demand drop amid restricted product availability, soaring fuel prices and a deteriorating economic outlook linked to the West Asia conflict. Although global diesel prices have eased from the all-time highs of more than 200 dollars per barrel reached last month, yet benchmarks remain nearly double the price of crude oil and their pre-crisis levels. The agency noted that diesel markets remained under significant strain as prolonged supply disruptions forced counter-seasonal stock draws ahead of autumn refinery maintenance and peak winter demand. Global oil demand is projected to recover by 2 million barrels a day next year, less than its previous forecast of 2.6 million bpd.

. The exports of coir and coir products have registered an increase of 305%, from 1,630.33 crore rupees in 2014-15 to 6,614.40 crore rupees in the last financial year.The Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) said that in the last 12 years, more than 21,000 coir units have been registered on the Udyam Registration Portal, employing around 230,000 people and bringing them into the formal Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises ecosystem. The Ministry further highlighted that more than 68 thousand people have been trained under various programmes in the sector, with women accounting for over 80% of the trainees. The sector has also seen the development of more than 150 innovative machines, technologies and value-added products. The MSME Ministry said that financial assistance of more than 20 crore rupees has also been provided to over 850 entrepreneurs under the Export Market Promotion scheme.India is the world’s largest producer and exporter of coir, accounting for about two-thirds of global production. The Indian Coir Industry has a turnover of approximately 16,000 crore and contributes close to 1% of India’s GDP. Coir pith, fibre, yarn and tufted mats are the major coir products exported by India.

. External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar said the countries are responding to the changing global order according to their specific situations, exploring new partnerships and fresh options. He cited the India-UAE partnership of the last decade as a great example of the two nations responding to the changing global environment.Dr. Jaishankar is on an official visit to the United Arab Emirates from 14th to 16th October, 2026 to participate in the 2nd edition of Raisina Middle East event. He arrived in Abu Dhabi last evening and was welcomed upon arrival by UAE Minister of State for International Cooperation Reem Al Hashimy.Speaking at the Raisina Middle East event in Abu Dhabi, Jaishankar joined UAE Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Abdullah Bin Zayed Al-Nahyan for a session on ‘The World Ahead: Power, Purpose & Possibility’.In their conversation, Dr. Jaishankar said it is important to recognise the pace of change in the global order, which reflects both long-term trends and immediate shocks. He noted that the countries respond to this according to their specific situations, exploring partnerships and fresh options in that pursuit. This also involves going beyond traditional comfort zones and developing sharper strategic awareness, he added. He further underlined the importance of urgent reform of multilateralism, supported through stronger minilateralism. Dr. Jaishankar cited India-UAE partnership of the last decade as a great example of the two nations responding to the changing global environmentDr. Jaishankar also held a meeting with UAE Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Abdullah Bin Zayed Al-Nahyan, which he described as a warm and productive meeting. The two sides exchanged perspectives on bilateral and global issues in the spirit of the India-UAE Comprehensive Strategic Partnership.Dr. Jaishankar also met Georgia’s Foreign Minister Maka Botchorishvili. He said India-Georgia ties, including in trade, tourism and education, have been expanding. The two sides discussed further deepening cooperation in business, connectivity, culture and people-to-people domains. They also discussed the current regional developments.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has completed 25 years in public service, a journey defined by the mantra of Jan Seva Se Desh Seva, and a relentless commitment that continues. Guided by this vision for Seva and Sushasan, the Government has been ceaselessly working towards achieving the goal of a Viksit Bharat by 2047. Through inclusive development and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming lives. Today, in our special series, we bring you an instance of how this vision has been translated into action through institutions like RERA, which are working towards transparency and consumer rights in the real estate sector.Parliament enacted the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act in 2016, paving the way for the establishment of Real Estate Regulatory Authorities (RERAs) in states. Under the Act, real estate projects must be registered with the regulatory authority before developers can advertise, market or sell properties, subject to the applicable provisions of the law.RERA provides a regulatory mechanism for addressing disputes between developers and homebuyers, ensuring greater transparency and accountability in the real estate sector.Prime Minister Narendra Modi said that RERA has played a significant role in strengthening trust between homebuyers and developers.Anil Tiwari, a resident of Gautam Buddha Nagar, said RERA has enhanced transparency between developers and homebuyers. He added that the regulatory framework has encouraged builders to commence projects on time and enabled homebuyers to receive possession of their homes as scheduled.RERA has helped improve relations between developers and homebuyers while providing legal protection to the rights and interests of property buyers.

. Benchmark domestic equity indices were trading over 0.3 per cent down during the last hour of trade today. The Sensex slipped 225 points to 72,808, while the Nifty dropped 92 points to 22,630, when reports last came in.In the broader market at the National Stock Exchange, the Midcap 100 index eked out a marginal loss of 0.1 per cent, while the Smallcap 100 index fell 0.3 per cent.In the Sensex pack, 19 out of 30 constituent companies registered losses. Among the top underperformers, Bajaj Finance tanked over two and a half per cent, Mahindra and Mahindra slipped over 2.2 per cent, and Bajaj Finserv fell two per cent. In contrast, Infosys rose two and a half per cent, Tech Mahindra gained 2.2 per cent, and TCS surged over one and a half per cent.In the sectoral indices on the BSE, 17 out of 28 sectors edged lower. Among the top laggards, Housing Finance dropped 1.1 per cent, Insurance slipped one per cent, and Healthcare dipped over 0.9 per cent. In contrast, Utilities surged nearly 2.1 per cent, Power advanced over 1.7 per cent, and IT gained 1.4 per cent.The overall market breadth at the BSE was positive, as shares of 2563 companies advanced, 1810 declined and 205 remained unchanged.

. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a red colour warning for heavy to very heavy rainfall with isolated extremely heavy rainfall over Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand tomorrow. According to IMD, heavy to very heavy rainfall is likely over Chhattisgarh and Madhya Pradesh tomorrow. The districts that are likely to receive heavy rainfall include Rampur, Pilibhit, Bareilly, Shahjahanpur and Bahraich. Meanwhile, districts of Madhya Pradesh which are expected to receive rainfall include Satna, Chhatarpur, Tikamgarh and Niwari.IMD said that the line of withdrawal of Southwest Monsoon continues to pass through Gurdaspur, Chandigarh, Muzaffarnagar, Aligarh, Dholpur, Udaipur, Deesa and Naliya.The Met Department has also predicted heavy rainfall over Delhi, Haryana, Chandigarh, Bihar, Himachal Pradesh, Jharkhand, Odisha, Sub-Himalayan West Bengal and Sikkim for the day. Thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty windsare expectedto prevail over Punjab, Madhya Pradesh, Vidarbha, Andhra Pradesh, Kerala, Mahe, Telangana, Andaman and Nicobar Islands and parts of Northeast during the next two days.Meanwhile, parts of Delhi are expected to witness light to moderate rainfall tomorrow.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi will interact with the Indian contingent that participated in the Asian Games 2026 in New Delhi this evening. The Prime Minister will also address the gathering on the occasion.India finished fourth in the medal tally at the Asian Games held in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, winning 85 medals, including 21 gold, 27 silver and 37 bronze. This marked India’s second consecutive finish among the top five nations at the Asian Games, reflecting the country’s growing competitiveness across a diverse range of sporting disciplines. India also recorded several notable achievements at the Games, including historic performances in recurve archery, gold medals for both the men’s and women’s hockey teams in the same edition, and maiden medals in soft tennis and mixed martial arts. Other significant achievements included India’s first-ever gold medal in the women’s trap event, a silver medal in weightlifting at the Asian Games after a gap of 28 years, and a silver medal in Greco-Roman wrestling, ending a 64-year wait for an Indian finalist in the discipline.

. The National Medical Commission has issued an advisory on the use of digital and electronic signatures for the remote review and authentication of medical records. The move aims to ensure uniform practices, protect patient safety and promote the responsible use of digital healthcare technologies.In a public notice issued yesterday, the NMC said differing practices among healthcare establishments had created uncertainty over remote authentication of medical records. The commission also cited a recommendation by the High-Level Committee on Non-Financial Regulatory Reforms to facilitate digital and electronic signatures in medical practice in accordance with the Information Technology Act, 2000.The NMC said the advisory seeks to remove ambiguity, maintain professional accountability and improve access to healthcare by reducing avoidable regulatory hurdles. It has advised all registered medical practitioners and other concerned stakeholders to comply with the advisory.

. Indian opener Shafali Verma was named the ‘ICC Women’s Player of the Month’ winner for September 2026, following incredible title-winning outings in the Women’s Asia Cup and the Asian Games with the bat and clutch contributions in high-stakes matches. On the other hand, Indian captain Shubman Gill was named ICC men’s Player of the Month for a record fifth time following his outstanding performance in the One Day International series against the West Indies.It is the second time Shafali has won the monthly award, with the 22-year-old first tasting success in November last year when she helped India claim the ICC Women’s Cricket World Cup on home soil, as per the ICC. Shafali Verma, was the highest run-scorer for her team as India won the Women’s Asia Cup.Shubman Gill, as per the ICC, won the award ahead of fellow nominees Abhishek Sharma of India and Zimbabwe’s Sikandar Raza. Gill scored 333 runs in India’s first two One Day Internationals against West Indies, with a century in the opener and an unbeaten double century in the second. India won both matches by eight wickets. This is Gill’s fifth ICC Men’s Player of the Month award, after wins in January 2023, September 2023, February 2025 and July 2025, extending his record as the men’s player with the most wins.

. Today is World Cotton Day. This day is celebrated annually on October 7 to highlight the global economic, social, and environmental importance of cotton. The theme for this year is Cotton for Good: Building Prosperity Through Trade, Transformation and Partnership. Sharing a video message, Union Textiles Minister Giriraj Singh extended greetings to everyone associated with this sector.He said that this day honours farmers who cultivate cotton in the fields, thereby enabling employment for workers across the entire value chain, whether in spinning mills, ginneries, textile manufacturing units, or garment factories. He informed that 60 lakh farmers in the country are engaged in cotton cultivation. He underlined that countless small enterprises are linked to the handloom industries that not only operate domestically but also export their products.

. Facing criticism over the diesel deal with Russia, US President Donald Trump defended a deal to release Russian diesel into global markets, saying it is intended to ease high fuel prices and is not meant for the United States. Trump said last Friday that Russia will supply more than 3 lakh tons of diesel, followed by 5 lakh tons in November and 1 million tons thereafter. The US Treasury Department issued a temporary license easing sanctions on Russian diesel shipments until April 7, 2027.

. Union Home Minister Amit Shah paid tribute to the former President, Dr APJ Abdul Kalam, on his Birth Anniversary today. In a social media post, he said that Dr APJ Abdul Kalam dedicated his rare scientific genius to making India a significant strategic power and upheld the highest democratic values as the President of India. Mr Shah added that The Missile Man of India will remain an ideal who will continue to inspire the younger generation to put their heart and soul into serving the nation.

. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast heavy rainfall over Andaman and Nicobar Islands, South Interior Karnataka and Uttarakhand tomorrow. It has also predicted thunderstorms accompanied with lightning and gusty winds over North Eastern parts of India, including Assam, Meghalaya, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram and Tripura, during the next two days. According to IMD, Himachal Pradesh, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Karaikal, Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Madhya Maharashtra, Marathwada, Odisha and Telangana are also likely to witness similar weather conditions tomorrow.

The Indian Embassy in Riyadh has urged all Indian nationals to continue to follow local authorities’ instructions, stay indoors in case of an aerial attack, and refrain from circulating videos or news related to ongoing events in view of the current situation in Saudi Arabia. In a fresh advisory, the Embassy informed that two Indian nationals who were injured in the Riyadh airport attack on the 10th of October continue to remain in the ICU. One Indian national has been shifted from the ICU to the High Dependency Unit. Four more Indian nationals continue to receive medical care in a normal ward, and one person was discharged from the hospital.Flight operations continue to remain suspended at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh. Flight operations at Dammam, Jeddah, and Medina continue, with some disruptions. Indian carriers have suspended flights to and from Saudi Arabia until the 17th of October. Saudia Airlines continues to operate scheduled flights from Dammam, Jeddah, and Medina. Flynas is operating scheduled flights on the Dammam-Lucknow sector.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has completed 25 years in public service, a journey defined by the mantra of Jan Seva Se Desh Seva, and a relentless commitment that continues. Guided by this vision for Seva and Sushasan, the Government has been ceaselessly working towards achieving the goal of a Viksit Bharat by 2047. Through inclusive development and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming lives. Located at Teen Murti Marg in New Delhi, the Pradhanmantri Sangrahalaya inspires the younger generation by showcasing the vision, leadership and contributions of all the Prime Ministers.Pradhanmantri Sangrahalaya, inaugurated by the Prime Minister Narendra Modi in 2022, highlights the contributions of all the Prime Ministers to the nation’s development. The museum showcases how Indian democracy has provided opportunities for leaders from every section of society to contribute to nation-building. Spread across two buildings, the modern digital museum offers visitors an insight into India’s political history, democratic traditions and journey of development. The Sangrahalaya features a Light and Sound Show titled ‘Veeranganaon ki Mahagatha’, which narrates the inspiring stories of valiant women warriors who fought to uphold the nation’s pride. Inaugurating the Pradhanmantri Sangrahalaya, Prime Minister Modi described the museum as a living symbol of the shared heritage and collective contributions of all governments.During his visit to the Pradhanmantri Sangrahalaya, Justice S. Thurairaja of Sri Lanka shared his reflections on India’s democratic journey and the leadership that has shaped the nation.

The Sports Ministry has removed para-shooting coach Jai Prakash Nautiyal from India’s contingent for the Para Asian Games amid allegations of selection irregularities and demands for an investigation. Long-serving national coach Jeevan L. Rai will replace him. The ministry has also approved 166 athletes for the Para Asian Games, which will begin on October 18 in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan. India won a record 108 medals, including 27 gold, at the previous edition of the Para Asian Games, crossing the 100-medal mark for the first time.
. In the Indian bullion market today, 24 carat gold was one per cent down at 1,46,064 rupees per 10 grams. Silver dipped 2.4 per cent to 2,13,822 rupees per kilogram.

. The National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) has postponed the implementation of the Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) on select Person-to-Merchant UPI transactions. Earlier, NPCI had announced that the rate would come into effect from today. The implementation will now take place after Diwali.In a social media post, National Payments Corporation of India said that UPI and Services Steering Committee decided that, keeping in mind the festive season, MDR on select Person-to-Merchant  UPI transactions will be implemented immediately post Diwali. It said, the date will be notified separately.All person-to-person UPI transactions will remain free regardless of amount. The MDR charges will apply only to person-to-merchant transactions exceeding two thousand rupees. Around 96% of person-to-merchant UPI transactions will remain unaffected. Small merchants, including street vendors, receiving up to one lakh rupees per month through UPI QR codes under the Person-to-Person-Merchant category will continue to enjoy zero MDR on all transactions.

. The Union Cabinet, chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, has approved a Productivity Linked Bonus (PLB) equivalent to 78 days’ wages for over 1,140,000 railway employees. Briefing the media after the Cabinet meeting, Information and Broadcasting Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said the government has allocated over 2,009 crore rupees for this payout. The maximum bonus amount payable per eligible employee is 17, 951 for 78 days. It covers Group C railway personnel, including track maintainers, loco pilots, train managers (guards), station masters, supervisors, technicians, pointsmen, and ministerial staff.Cabinet has also approved the continuation of the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) for five years, covering the period from 2026-27 to 2030-31 with a total budget of 53 thousand 428 crore rupees. The programme is being renamed as the Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana. A total of 3.20 crore beneficiaries across all 36 States and Union Territories will benefit from this social security net expansion.The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) has approved strategic restructuring of IDBI Bank. It was decided that 60.72% of the equity stake in IDBI Bank will be sold to a strategic buyer. Canada-based Fairfax Financial Holdings Ltd has been selected as the strategic buyer. Fairfax will acquire a controlling 60.72% stake in the bank for a total purchase consideration of over 52,878 crore rupees.

. Most Asian stock markets edged lower today. China’s Shanghai Composite fell 0.9 per cent, South Korea’s Kospi index dropped over 0.4 per cent, Hong Kong’s Hang Seng as well as Singapore’s Strait Times slipped 0.13 per cent, and Japan’s Nikkei 225 ended marginally down. On the other hand, Taiwan’s Taiex rose 0.6 per cent.In European markets, Germany’s DAX gained 0.7 per cent, and London’s FTSE 100 added 0.3 per cent, when reports last came in.

. The AYUSH Ministry has issued standard treatment guidelines on Management of Dermatological Disorders for Ayurveda, Siddha, Unani and Homoeopathy, with the inclusion of Yoga. The document has been prepared by the Ayush Vertical of the Directorate General of Health Services and Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. The Ministry said that the document is intended to bring more uniformity, quality assurance and evidence-informed practice to clinical care across the Ayush systems. Ayush Minister Prataprao Jadhav underlined that these guidelines will deepen the integration of Ayush systems with the national healthcare framework. He said that by promoting standardised and evidence-informed clinical practice, the guiidelines will contribute to improving patient care and strengthening the role of Ayush systems in public health.

The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds over  Haryana, Chandigarh, Delhi, Punjab, Chhattisgarh, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal for tomorrow. Similar weather conditions are expected over Andhra Pradesh and West Rajasthan.  IMD said that conditions are likely to become favourable for further withdrawal of southwest monsoon from some more parts of eastern India and many parts of northeast India during the next two days. Himachal Pradesh, Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh and Kerala can also experience thunderstorms accompanied with Lightning.

. In Men’s Cricket, the West Indies defeated India by 24 runs in the fourth T20 International in Hyderabad last night. Chasing a target of 248 runs set by West Indies, India scored 223 for nine in 19.3 overs. Sanju Samson was the top scorer with 56 runs. Tilak Varma scored 43 runs. Arshdeep Singh retired hurt with 5 runs. For West Indies, Keemo Paul scalped 5 wickets.Earlier, put into bat, West Indies posted 247 runs for the loss of three wickets in the stipulated 20 overs. West Indies Captain Shai Hope scored an unbeaten 102 runs off 50 balls. Shai Hope was adjudged the Player of the Match.The five-match series is now levelled at 2-2. The last match of the series will be played on 17th of this month at M.Chinnaswamy Stadium, Bengaluru.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi today expressed happiness over the successful surgery of Pope Leo the Fourteenth, which was held last night. In a social media post, Mr Modi wished the Pope a full and speedy recovery as well as continued good health.

. The Baloch Yakjehti Committee (BYC) has reported two separate killings of Baloch civilians, accusing Pakistani security personnel of involvement in these incidents in Balochistan.  These incidents have intensified concerns over enforced disappearances, extrajudicial executions and civilian safety in Balochistan. The Balochistan Post reported that one victim had remained missing for more than nine months before his body was recovered in Barkhan recently.The BYC said military intelligence personnel took him from outside the Sessions Court in Rakhni on December 26. In a separate incident, another person from Loti in Dera Bugti, was shot dead by Pakistani Coast Guard personnel in Winder on October 11. The BYC urged international human rights organisations to intervene over what it described as a continuing pattern of enforced disappearances followed by killings and extrajudicial executions. It also appealed to the United Nations to take urgent notice of these incidents. BYC’s report covering January to June 2026 recorded 150 civilian deaths, including 15 minors.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has offered prayers to Maa Skandamata, marking the fifth day of Navratri today. In a social media post, Mr Modi wished that the blessings of the Goddess, symbolising maternal love and affection, would bring love, peace and harmony to every family.

. India’s Wholesale Price Index (WPI) based inflation rose sharply to 11.39% in September, from 9.92% in August, on an annual basis. According to the provisional data released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, the annual inflation last month was driven by higher prices of mineral oils, food articles, crude petroleum and natural gas, coal and lignite, basic metals, chemicals and chemical products, textiles, rubber and plastic products and electrical equipment.Among the major categories in WPI, year-on-year inflation in the Fuel and Power group surged to 25.85% in September, from 22.93% in August. Inflation in Manufactured Products rose to 9.76%, from 8.37%, and inflation in Primary Articles edged up to 8.67%, from 7.76%, during the same period. The WPI Food Index, which comprises food articles and food products, rose to 8.66% in September, from 7.05% in August. The Output Producer Price Index increased by 11.38% year-on-year in September. According to the data, cumulative WPI inflation during the first half of this financial year stood at 9.85%, compared with a contraction of 0.2% during the corresponding period of the previous financial year.

. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh today felicitated sportspersons from the three Services for winning 27 medals at the recently concluded Asian Games in Japan. The athletes won six gold, eleven silver and ten bronze medals, contributing significantly to India’s overall tally of 85 medals andfourth-place finish. Addressing the athletes, Mr Singh praised their discipline, hard work and team spirit. He lauded the Mission Olympic Wing, coaches and support staff for their role in identifying and nurturing sporting talent.Defence Minister reiterated the Prime Minister Narendra Modi-led Government’s commitment to strengthening India’s sporting ecosystem, with sustained focus on infrastructure, modern training facilities and better opportunities for athletes.The Defence Minister also urged the athletes and trainers to adopt a focused approach towards the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics, expressing confidence that the Services would deliver an even stronger performance.

In a social media post, National Payments Corporation of India said that UPI and Services Steering Committee today decided that, keeping in mind the festive season, MDR on select Person-to-Merchant UPI transactions will be implemented immediately post Diwali.

. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio will visit India next week to strengthen energy cooperation and strategic partnership between the two countries. US State Department said, Mr Rubio will travel to Mumbai and Jamnagar during his tour. State Department said, he will meet with senior government officials to strengthen India-US strategic partnership, exchange views on regional and global dynamics, and discuss prospects for enhanced energy cooperation. Mr Rubio will also meet business leaders to promote investment and economic cooperation. This will be Mr Rubio’s second visit to India since May, when he attended the Quad Foreign Ministers’ meeting hosted by External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar in New Delhi.Before arriving in India, Mr Rubio will participate in the C5+1 Ministerial meeting in Samarkand, Uzbekistan. The meeting will focus on how strategic cooperation through the diplomatic platform can promote a more peaceful and prosperous future for the US and Central Asian countries. Mr Rubio will also hold bilateral meetings with senior officials from the five Central Asian countries – Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan and the Kyrgyz Republic. A US commercial delegation comprising more than 200 business leaders will accompany Mr Rubio to promote stronger commercial cooperation between the US and Central Asia.

. Union Minister for Finance and Corporate Affairs, Nirmala Sitharaman, arrived in Bangkok today. She was received at Suvarnabhumi Airport by India’s Ambassador to Thailand, Puneet Agrawal, and Deputy Director General of Thailand’s Treasury Department, Ruecha Varatorn.During her visit, the Finance Minister will attend the Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank. She will also participate in the G-20 and G-7 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors’ meetings. Besides, she is scheduled to hold bilateral meetings with many countries and organisations in Bangkok.

. In cricket, India defeated the West Indies by 14 runs in the third T20 International at the Holkar Stadium in Indore last night.Chasing a target of 224 runs, the West Indies managed to score 209 for seven in their stipulated 20 overs. Shimron Hetmyer was the top scorer with 43 runs, while Kamil Pooran scored 42. For India, Arshdeep Singh took three wickets.Earlier, the West Indies won the toss and opted to bowl. Batting first, India were bowled out for 223 in 20 overs. Abhishek Sharma played a superb knock of 69 runs off 30 balls. For the West Indies, Roston Chase, Shamar Joseph and Shamar Springer took two wickets each. Arshdeep Singh was adjudged Player of the Match.India had defeated the West Indies by eight wickets in the opening T20 International in Lucknow. In the second match on Friday, the West Indies beat India by six wickets in Ranchi to level the series. . The Indian Meteorological Department (IMD) hasissued redalert for extremely heavy rainfall over isolated places of Chhattisgarh, Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Odisha and Telangana for the next two days. The Met Department has predicted heavy rainfall over Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Meghalaya, Bihar, Jharkhand, Kerala, Maharashtra, West Bengal and Sikkim tomorrow. The weather department also forecast thunderstorms accompanied with highly gusty winds over Madhya Pradesh and Parts of North-East tomorrow.For Delhi, IMD said the national capital will witness mostly clear skies with no rain. The maximum temperature in Delhi is expected to be around 34 to 35 degrees Celsius, while the minimum temperature of 23 to 25 degrees Celsius.

Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman has said that India’s reform trajectory has reached another milestone today with the CCEA’s approval of IDBI Bank’s strategic restructuring.In a social media post, the Finance Minister said that the Government is now enabling its next phase of growth through the infusion of Foreign Direct Investment while retaining a minority stake. Ms Sitharaman said that this will not only strengthen the banking ecosystem but also help banking services surpass global benchmarks. She added that the restructuring of IDBI Bank reinforces that India’s growth story is strong, its economy is resilient, and the government’s commitment to reform is unwavering. She said the Government is shaping a future-ready financial sector dedicated to empowering customers, backing entrepreneurs, and fuelling the vision of a Viksit Bharat with an unshakable resolve toward economic transformation

. Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman met the UK Chancellor of the Exchequer, John Healey, on the sidelines of the annual meetings in Bangkok today. In a social media post, the Finance Ministry said that they discussed the successful conclusion of the 4th India-UK Financial Markets Dialogue, FinTech meetings and associated IUKFP meetings, building on the outcomes of the last Economic and Financial Dialogue.During the meeting, the Finance Minister reaffirmed India’s commitment to working closely with UK towards shared priorities and a constructive, inclusive G20 process. Ms Sitharaman also informed him that India is looking forward to the 14th Economic and Financial Dialogue (EFD) with proposed collaboration in critical minerals, Green Tech and city-region partnerships. Both sides affirmed the next EFD to be held in December this year.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate and dedicate five major development projects worth around ₹ 3,350 crore in Ladakh today through video conferencing. The projects aim to strengthen connectivity, improve energy infrastructure, conserve cultural heritage and enhance water security in the region. He will also address the gathering. The Prime Minister will inaugurate the New Passenger Terminal Building at Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport, Leh, built at 640 crore rupees. The modern terminal is spread over 23,800 square metres and designed to handle 35 lakh passengers annually.The Prime Minister will dedicate to the nation the 298-km-long Nimmu-Padum-Darcha Road, constructed by the Border Roads Organisation (BRO). Connecting Nimmu in Leh with Darcha in Himachal Pradesh through the remote Zanskar Valley, the road provides an alternative connectivity corridor to Ladakh, supplementing the Srinagar-Leh and Manali-Leh highways.Mr Modi will also inaugurate the nine-megawatt Hanu Small Hydroelectric Project and the 66 kV Double-Circuit Dah-Hanu-Khaltsi Transmission Line. The projects will strengthen power evacuation infrastructure and improve the reliability of Ladakh’s electricity network. Mr Modi will inaugurate India’s first Petroglyph Conservation Park at Sindhu Ghat, Leh and 40 water bodies developed across 40 villages under Project Him Sarovar.The five projects will strengthen connectivity, improve energy infrastructure, conserve cultural heritage and enhance water security in the region. Prime Minister will inaugurate the New Passenger Terminal Building at Kushok Bakula Rinpochey Airport, Leh, built at a cost of ₹640 crore. Spread over 23,800 square metres, the modern terminal is designed to handle 35 lakh passengers annually. Prime Minister will also dedicate to the nation the 298-km-long Nimmu – Padum- Darcha Road, constructed by the Border Roads Organisation (BRO). Connecting Nimmu in Leh with Darcha in Himachal Pradesh through the remote Zanskar Valley, the road provides an alternative connectivity corridor to Ladakh, supplementing the Srinagar-Leh and Manali-Leh highways. As part of efforts to strengthen energy security and harness Ladakh’s renewable energy potential, Prime Minister will inaugurate the 9 MW Hanu Small Hydroelectric Project and the 66 kV Double-Circuit Dah- Hanu- Khaltsi Transmission Line.The projects will strengthen power evacuation infrastructure and improve the reliability of Ladakh’s electricity network. They mark an important step towards harnessing the region’s hydropower resources and strengthening its energy infrastructure. Recognising the importance of preserving Ladakh’s ancient archaeological heritage, Prime Minister will inaugurate India’s first Petroglyph Conservation Park at Sindhu Ghat, Leh. Ladakh is home to hundreds of prehistoric rock art sites. These petroglyphs are an irreplaceable record of the region’s cultural and civilisational past. The conservation park will provide a dedicated space for protecting these vulnerable archaeological remains, raising public awareness and encouraging responsible heritage tourism. Prime Minister will also inaugurate 40 water bodies developed across 40 villages under Project Him Sarovar, an initiative aimed at addressing Ladakh’s unique geographical and climatic challenges through water conservation, in line with the objectives of Mission Amrit Sarovar. Project Him Sarovar seeks to address this challenge by conserving water when it is available and ensuring its availability when required, thereby supporting irrigation, sustaining agricultural livelihoods and strengthening long-term water security in the region.

The Commission for Air Quality Management in NCR and Adjoining Areas conducted a special inspection drive in Delhi to assess road dust and effectiveness of road cleaning operations across the city.The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change has informed that the commission deployed four flying squad teams for the inspection which was carried out yesterday. The Flying Squad Teams inspected 25 road stretches covering approximately 35 kilometres of the Inner and Outer ring road which come under the jurisdiction of the Public Works Department (PWD), Delhi.The Ministry highlighted that the inspections, which were meant to seek strict implementation of road cleaning and dust mitigation measures, found 17 cases of violation. These violations include accumulation of construction and demolition waste and high visible road dust across inspected road stretches.CAQM has directed PWD, Delhi and other concerned agencies to take appropriate corrective measures to control road dust on priority basis. It also added the inspection shall continue under Operation Clean Air across Delhi-NCR to assess on-ground implementation of various air pollution abatement measures.

. Union Sports Minister Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya today inaugurated the BRICS Traditional and Indigenous Sports Demonstration Games 2026 at the Veer Savarkar Sports Complex in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. The Union Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports organised the games in collaboration with the Gujarat Government.Addressing the inaugural ceremony, Dr. Mandaviya emphasised that traditional and indigenous sports serve as a vital bridge, preserving cultural identity while unlocking new opportunities for global collaboration. The Minister added that under Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s leadership, initiatives like Khelo India are fostering a sustainable sports ecosystem from the grassroots to the international level.Mentioning upcoming international events in Ahmedabad, Gujarat Deputy Chief Minister Harsh Sanghavi proposed five key initiatives for BRICS nations to preserve indigenous sports, including creatinga joint multilingual digital archive and integrating traditional games into academic curricula.Designed as a non-competitive platform, the Games brought together delegations from member and partner countries who presented a diverse range of indigenous sports.

. Ukraine has accused the United States of helping Russia as it fails to provide timely warnings about Russian missile strikes and has raised concerns over Starlink restrictions. The accusation follows massive Russian aerial assaults that killed nine people, targeted power and heating plants, and cut electricity to over 6 lakh residents. The ballistic missiles hit Kyiv before air raid sirens could activate.Ties between Kyiv and Washington have deteriorated after US President Donald Trump lifted sanctions on Russian diesel, criticised Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, urged a halt to strikes on Russian refineries, and suggested replacing Ukraine’s wartime leader.

. India’s Anandkumar Velkumar won a silver medal in the men’s 1000 meter sprint category at the World Skating Games in Paraguay. He missed out on a chance to win gold by a narrow margin and ended up finishing second on the podium. He displayed an excellent performance in the men’s 1000-meter sprint event, clocking a time of 1 minute 21.922 seconds. The time difference between the gold medalist and Anandkumar was just 4 milliseconds. Anandkumar has won two medals so far at the 2026 World Skate, and he will have an opportunity to bag another medal as he will compete in the Marathon on Sunday. He had bagged bronze in the 500-meter sprint.
